'''Wesk Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of<ref name="SW:CWA" /> nine<ref name="Squads" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], including one [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] and four [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]],<ref name="SW:CWA" /> that served within one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]]<ref name="Squads" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The squad shared its name with<ref name="SW:CWA" /> the letter [[Wesk/Legends|Wesk]], the twenty-third letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet.<ref name="Name">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

During the war, Wesk Squad's four ARF [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;who wielded<ref name="SW:CWA" /> [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]]<ref name="DC15A">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and had [[Color/Legends|orange-brown]] camouflage on their armor, and the squad's ARC trooper&mdash;who wore olive-colored [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC trooper armor]] without a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], participated in a [[Third battle of Felucia|third battle]] on the<ref name="SW:CWA" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Felucia">{{DB|location|felucia|Felucia}}</ref> [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where they made use of four [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] adorned with blue markings.<ref name="SW:CWA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures''}}
During the battle, Wesk Squad captured eighteen supply crates from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and held them north of a [[Republic outpost  (Felucia)|Republic outpost]] on the planet. They sent out a message requesting that the supplies be picked up and sent to [[Republic Strategic Command|Republic Command]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] received the request and later carried the squad's supplies back to the Republic outpost, which were then sent to Republic Command.<ref name="SW:CWA" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wesk Squad appeared in a [[2013]] update for [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], a massively multiplayer online [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]<ref name="SW:CWA" /> on [[September 15]], [[2010]].<ref name="SW:CWA BTS">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_date/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 3 Premiere Date Announced}}</ref>
